target.title: fix(queue): unblock exact-review publication
target.body:
<!-- submission-timestamps:start -->
First submitted: July 15, 2026, 12:56 PM (US Eastern Time) / 16:56 UTC.
Last body edit: July 15, 2026, 12:56 PM (US Eastern Time) / 16:56 UTC.
Latest head commit: July 15, 2026, 12:55 PM (US Eastern Time) / 16:55 UTC.
<!-- submission-timestamps:end -->

Closes #606

## Summary

Unblock exact-review result publication by making the Durable Object queue the sole exact-publisher serializer, replacing the seven-day unclaimed publication lease with a bounded 15-minute claim window, yielding repeatedly unclaimed artifacts to later results, and using the publication-specific lease when calculating handoff health.

## Breaking changes

None. Queue payloads, lease tuple validation, immutable artifact validation, target comment markers, and state record formats are unchanged.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where completed exact-review results would remain absent from their original durable review comments when broad state publisher jobs occupied the shared GitHub Actions concurrency queue.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Durable Object already admits only one exact publisher. The additional Actions concurrency group created a second, unobservable queue behind unrelated broad publishers. Removing that duplicate serialization lets exact publication start directly, while the bounded claim lease and retry backoff recover lost dispatches without allowing one artifact to monopolize the single publisher slot.

## User Impact

Completed reviews can reach their marker-backed durable comments without waiting behind broad state publication. Re-review progress can finish, later artifacts can make progress after one unclaimed dispatch, and operators receive an accurate stalled handoff signal.

## Implementation

- Remove `event-review-publish` from the shared `clawsweeper-state-publisher` Actions concurrency group. Exact publication remains serialized by `ExactReviewQueue`.
- Reduce the unclaimed publication dispatch lease from seven days to 15 minutes.
- Back off an expired publication before redispatch so later artifacts can use the publisher slot.
- Pass each queue item's effective dispatch lease into health summarization.
- Document and configure the production publication claim window.

## Code-path analysis

- Runtime entry: signed intake reaches `ExactReviewQueue` in `dashboard/worker.ts`; its alarm owns admission, dispatch leases, and retries.
- Queue owner: `ExactReviewQueue.alarm`, `reclaimExpiredExactReviewLeases`, `exactReviewQueueAdmittedItems`, and `exactReviewQueueNextWakeAt` in `dashboard/worker.ts`.
- Workflow caller: generation uploads an immutable bundle and enqueues `exact_review_artifact_publish` in `.github/workflows/sweep.yml`.
- Publication callee: `event-review-publish` claims the exact queue lease, validates the bundle, and calls `repair:publish-event-result`.
- Durable comment owner: `src/clawsweeper.ts` selects the marker-backed bot comment and PATCHes it in place, or POSTs only when no durable comment exists.
- State convergence: `src/repair/publish-event-result.ts` applies the verified tuple and retries state publication up to 20 times.
- Sibling publisher: broad `publish` remains serialized by `clawsweeper-state-publisher`; this change does not alter its behavior.
- Tests: `test/dashboard-worker.test.ts`, `test/exact-review-health.test.ts`, and `test/sweep-workflow.test.ts` cover lease recovery, fairness, health age, and workflow ownership.

## Mainline comparison

- Official repository/default branch: `openclaw/clawsweeper:main`
- Base SHA: `cd68a14528558cbc26932629c4bce49f314269b0`
- Base commit time: July 15, 2026, 12:49 PM US Eastern / 16:49 UTC
- Comparison refreshed: July 15, 2026, 12:56 PM US Eastern / 16:56 UTC
- The only later upstream change after the original investigation added containment smoke coverage and did not modify the exact-review queue, publisher workflow, or health surface.

## Branch / base provenance

- Base: `openclaw/clawsweeper:main@cd68a14528558cbc26932629c4bce49f314269b0`
- Head: `snowzlmbot/clawsweeper:fix/exact-review-publication-starvation@01cc7967ebc2d049b84ab3b8b0474d2bca89ed4a`
- The head branch contains one dedicated commit and no proof media, generated artifacts, state records, or unrelated changes.
- The fork default branch remains a read-only upstream mirror for this work.

## Dependency / contract verification

- No dependency or lockfile changes.
- GitHub `repository_dispatch` remains the dispatch transport.
- Protocol v2 lease identity, run attempt, claim generation, and stale-lease rejection are unchanged.
- Immutable artifact name, source SHA, producer decision, and target tuple validation are unchanged.
- Cloudflare Durable Object alarms remain the retry owner.
- Delayed workflows with an expired lease still fail closed at claim with a safe conflict.

## Labels considered

- `bug`
- `P1`
- `impact:other`
- `merge-risk: 🚨 automation`
- `merge-risk: 🚨 availability`

These are contributor suggestions; no upstream metadata change is assumed.

## Validation

Pre-submit static checks on the exact head:

- `pnpm run check:active-surface` — passed.
- `pnpm run check:limits` — passed.
- Focused `oxfmt --check` for all eight changed files — passed.
- YAML parser check for `.github/workflows/sweep.yml` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

The PR is opened as draft until GitHub-hosted CI completes on the exact head.

## Evidence source map

- [Starved publication workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29418496158): public production run; `Publish exact review artifact` waited behind 16 broad publishers.
- [Completed generation workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29409874087): uploaded the immutable artifact that the starved publisher was meant to persist.
- [Public queue status](https://clawsweeper.openclaw.ai/api/status): live queue and handoff telemetry.
- [Evidence branch and source map](https://github.com/snowzlmbot/clawsweeper/tree/evidence/exact-review-publication-starvation/evidence/exact-review-publication-starvation): sanitized screenshot and observation summary.
- GitHub-hosted PR CI: pending at initial submission; this section will be updated with the specific run URL and conclusion before the PR is marked ready.


## Media evidence

![The exact publisher waiting behind broad state publishers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/clawsweeper/evidence/exact-review-publication-starvation/evidence/exact-review-publication-starvation/pending-publisher.png)

A video is not required: the failure is a static Actions concurrency wait plus durable queue state, and the public run/status links preserve both observations.

## Risk

- Exact publication can now overlap one broad state publisher. The exact lane itself remains single-writer through the Durable Object.
- A state-branch race may add retry latency; `publish-event-result` already refreshes the authoritative remote tuple and retries up to 20 times.
- The 15-minute claim window can redispatch during unusually long GitHub admission delays. Old workflows cannot claim an expired lease, and publication identity remains immutable and idempotent.
- Backoff changes only expired publication leases; ordinary review recovery and one-shot failed-shard behavior are unchanged.
- No authorization, token scope, sandbox, close policy, or target selection behavior changes.

## Rollback

Revert the single commit and redeploy the dashboard Worker/workflow. No schema, migration, configuration data, or irreversible GitHub mutation is introduced. Existing immutable review artifacts retain their normal retention window and can be replayed by the prior path.

## Docs updated

- `docs/limits.md` documents the single publisher owner, 15-minute claim window, and fairness backoff.
- `dashboard/wrangler.toml` records the production claim-window value.

## Related issue / PR

- Closes #606.
- Related: #588, #592, #596, and #601.

## Not tested / limitations

- No production deployment was performed from this contribution.
- Post-deploy backlog drain and live durable-comment completion remain to be observed after merge/deployment.
- No private credentials, target mutations, live close/apply command, or non-public environment was used for proof.
